description: Run one read-only Slurm command on a ParallelClusterMaker node. The command set and the login user are closed sets enforced by SSM before dispatch; the switches arrive base64-encoded, so the parameter itself cannot carry a shell metacharacter and the decoded values are never re-parsed by the shell.

command.description: The Slurm command. scontrol always runs as 'scontrol show' -- the subcommand is written by this document, never taken from a parameter.

switchesB64.description: Switches as base64 of a newline-separated argument list. Base64 rather than plain text because a Slurm format string legitimately contains characters the shell would otherwise act on -- '-o %P|%a|%D' is the standard machine-readable idiom, and a pipe there is a field separator, not a pipeline. Encoded, the parameter is drawn from an alphabet with no shell meaning at all.

user.description: The cluster login user to run as. SSM executes as root; these commands have no business doing so, and $HOME would be wrong.
